post_title: Two rentals. Only one gets the loan. (The DSCR test)
caption:
Two rentals. Only one passes the lender's test. 🏦

The cheaper house wins on paper, then loses where it counts. Head to head:

• Price: $280K vs $300K. House A wins.
• Payment with taxes + insurance: $1,814 vs $1,935. House A wins.
• Rent: $1,850 vs $2,450. House B wins.
• DSCR (rent ÷ payment): 1.02 vs 1.27. Lenders want about 1.25. Only B gets the loan.

Cheaper isn't better if the bank says no.

Example numbers: 25% down, 7.25% 30-year DSCR loan; lender requirements vary.
